findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/pages/Common/MetricsView/widgetViewData.repeatedItems.test.ts, describe data list of the over-time charts
findings.obligation: E4: Work Items never in progress during the range do not appear in any of the four data lists
findings.observation: No Work Item outside the in-progress run chart is supplied. cycleTimeData, inProgressItems and workItemLookup are empty, so a list fed from another source would still pass; the falsifier of E4 cannot fire.
findings.remediation: Add a Work Item that is in cycleTimeData (or the lookup) but on no day of the wip run chart, and assert it is absent from the item list of all four charts for team and portfolio.

findings.location: Lighthouse.Frontend/src/pages/Common/MetricsView/widgetViewData.repeatedItems.test.ts, describe data list of the over-time charts
findings.obligation: E5: changing the selected range and reloading a chart still lists each in-progress Work Item exactly once
findings.observation: buildViewData is called once with one RunChartData. No second range and no reload is observed, so carry-over of a previous range is not falsifiable.
findings.remediation: Call buildViewData a second time with a different RunChartData in which an in-progress Work Item spans several days, and assert that each of the four charts lists it exactly once, with the ids of the second range only.
